name: Rong bien
summary: Seaweed from the Bãi Xếp fishing village, dried for a cool summer drink or cooked into chè.
origin: Bãi Xếp, 13 km south of the center on quốc lộ 1D, the Quy Nhơn–Sông Cầu road.
howToEat: Drink it in summer, or eat it in chè.
where: Bãi Xếp, 13 km south of the center on the Quy Nhơn–Sông Cầu road.
seoDescription: Bãi Xếp seaweed is dried for a cool summer drink or cooked into chè, in the fishing village south of Quy Nhon.
